description: Adds a slow random drift to a pitch voltage, on two independent channels

params.text: Sets how often a new random value is drawn for that channel, once a second counter-clockwise to eight times a second clockwise, and shortens the glide between values as it rises
Scales the drift added to that channel's input, none counter-clockwise to a few hundredths of a volt clockwise

inputs.text: The voltage to be drifted; nothing patched here leaves that channel's output at 0V

outputs.text: The input voltage of that channel with its drift added

notes: Each half is idle until a voltage is patched into its own IN: with nothing patched there no drift is computed and that half's OUT holds 0V.
